failedDescription: The link may have expired, been used, or been replaced by a resend. If you are signed in with a staff account, sign out and use a separate customer account.
readyDescription: Sign in with the account that received the invitation, or register first. An administrator never knows or sets your password.
redeemingDescription: We are checking the invitation and your signed-in account. Please do not repeat the action.
successDescription: The invitation was claimed and this login is now securely bound to the customer profile.
